svg.title: How open-diagram turns a script into a picture
svg.desc:
How open-diagram turns a script into a picture States shown: Live, Planned. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Your script (Written by you or an agent): Words in lists; Panels and tiles; Lines and groups - Measure (From the font file): Letter widths; Kerning pairs; Line wrapping - Place (Sizes come from Measure): Columns; Next to, below; Shaded groups - Check (Every rule, every build): Overlaps; Gaps under 16 px; Lines through boxes; Labels on boxes; Text under 10 px - Draw (Same look everywhere): Text as outlines; Curves and lanes; Key from what is used; 3D icons (planned) - Output (Files first, then problems): SVG file; PNG file; Problem report Lines: - Your script -> Measure - Measure -> Place - Place -> Check - Check -> Draw - Draw -> Output - Output -> Your script, labeled "Each problem comes back by name: fix it and run again"
